mcp__ppt__render_delivery.description: Ordinary bounded render-inspect-validate-deliver script. Writes only an approved new copy; not a learned Motif. Output fields describe successful delivery, not validation failure.

mcp__ppt__revise_delivery.description: Ordinary bounded explicit-page revision and delivery script. Rejects changed non-target OOXML; original deck is retained. Not a learned Motif.

mcp__ppt__pin_deck_pages.description: Pin explicit page numbers of a persisted current deck without choosing or modifying content.

mcp__ppt__read_pinned_deck_pages.description: Read the current persisted plans of explicitly pinned pages without semantic selection or edits.
